name: Shaman Voodoo Charm
summary: In Ban'ethil Barrow Den, Gnarlpine shamans wield the Shaman Voodoo Charm. Its vile magic can sever a sleeping druid's spirit from the body.

sections.title: A Perverted Magic
sections.body: The Gnarlpine tribe has fallen into madness and corruption on Teldrassil. Within Ban'ethil Barrow Den, its shamans wield magic beyond ordinary wilderness sorcery. Their voodoo charms let them tear a sleeping druid's consciousness from the mortal realm and trap it in the Emerald Dream. The furbolgs then animate the empty body. Night elf protectors become mindless guardians, killing anyone who enters the barrows.

sections.title: Unraveling the Curse
sections.body: Oben Rageclaw fell victim to the ritual. His spirit is trapped in the Emerald Dream while his animated body terrorizes the deep barrows. Reaching through the veil, Oben asked adventurers to slay the Gnarlpine shamans and bring back one of their charms. He hoped to study its vile enchantment, understand the furbolgs' twisted craft, and find a way to free his stolen flesh.

faq.q: What is the Shaman Voodoo Charm used for?
faq.answer: Gnarlpine shamans use the charm to sever a sleeping druid's spirit from the body and trap it in the Emerald Dream. The charm's magic animates the empty flesh to attack intruders.

aliases: where to find shaman voodoo charm
faq.answer: Gnarlpine shamans in the depths of Ban'ethil Barrow Den in Teldrassil carry these charms.

faq.q: Why does Oben Rageclaw need one?
faq.answer: Oben Rageclaw is trapped in the Emerald Dream while his animated body runs amok. He needs to study the charm's vile aura and magic to find a way to break the furbolgs' enchantment.

faq.q: Why do furbolgs have voodoo magic?
faq.answer: Corruption has driven the Gnarlpine shamans on Teldrassil to practice dark magic. Their charms carry a vile, unnatural aura, unlike traditional furbolg reverence for nature spirits and the elements.

angles.text: As a druid, you see the charm as a horrifying perversion of sacred slumber. Its dark magic traps the dreamer in the Emerald Dream and turns the body into a puppet.
As a night elf, you know the charms in Ban'ethil Barrow Den reveal how deeply the Gnarlpine have desecrated one of the kaldorei's holiest communal resting places.
